page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Below it one column of text lines in the centre, with brace-grouped labels in the left margin (Andomarí, Collegium, Cracoviæ, Collegiū, Vilnæ, Collegiū) beside the braces. Headings centred: PROVINCIA POLONIÆ and PROVINCIA LITVANIÆ. Catchword/page number absent. A partial word at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is ignored.
page.notes: Brace labels in the left margin (Andomari, Collegium, Cracoviæ, Collegiū, Vilnæ, Collegiū) are attached to their brace groups; their exact span is approximated. Page number not printed. The line "Su" at far right edge is the neighbouring page's running word and is omitted. Some lines show damaged letters (e.g. Ipresse, Cortracense, Valencenense) and may be misread.
